description: The native description identifies State Road Network data published by Spain's National Geographic Institute. Its Shapefile layers include official-catalogue sections, a network calibrated for linear referencing, kilometre markers and actual or virtual calibration points. These specifically described geometric and referencing inputs are not interchangeable with the broader CNIG catalogue, HERMES viewer or annual traffic-map information. CAMBER provides a restricted descriptive deposit; exact extract date, original layer identifier and accessible files remain unknown. The record preserves the national-network scope and source attribution without claiming a separately validated CAMBER derivative or new road survey. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
